To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) almost half of all smokers are interested in using Internet-based smoking cessation programs; 2) interest is associated with being young, highly motivated, highly dependent, having made a recent quit attempt, having regular Internet access and handheld computer access and having recently searched online for smoking cessation information and/or support; and 3) interest is not associated with socioeconomic status.
